name: Flaky Test Hunter
description: Reproduces a flaky test, names the real cause, and proves the fix.
about: Name a test that fails now and then and it reruns it in a loop — shuffled order, new seeds, different worker counts — until it fails, then reads the test and the code under test to say why: timing, shared state, the clock, randomness, the network. It proposes a real fix rather than a retry, and edits nothing without asking.
features: Reproduce intermittent failures by rerunning in a loop
Name the cause: timing, shared state, clocks, races
Prove the fix with a long clean rerun
examplePrompt: This test fails about one run in ten and passes on a retry. Reproduce it, tell me why, and fix the cause.
